claim: Reads one source sentence at a time without changing its punctuation
sandbox: Fresh extension DOM fixture; invoke its real message controls over abbreviations, initialisms, and decimals, then assert the utterance sequence reconstructs the normalized source exactly.

claim: Supports replay, slower speech, previous sentence, and next sentence controls
where: Landing preview, demo, extension popup, README
sandbox: Fresh test environment; send the same visible sentence to browser speech at 0.8 speed and assert the utterance, rate, previous action, and next action.
Fresh browser context at /demo; mock SpeechSynthesisUtterance and assert the sample control creates one utterance with its visible sentence.

claim: Listen Back does not send article text to a Listen Back server
where: Landing facts, limits, privacy page, extension popup, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; finish loading, clear the request log, read and navigate sample text, and assert the actions make no network request.

claim: Extension controls work offline after an article loads; speech depends on your browser voice
sandbox: Fresh production MV3 build in Chromium; load an article, take the context offline, invoke next and previous, and assert the source marker updates without a network request.

claim: Demo sample data is not saved
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; interact with controls, reset the route, and assert localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB remain empty and no request leaves same origin.

claim: The sample and extension are free to use without an account
where: Landing facts and install section, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; assert the working reader is immediately enabled with no sign-in, billing, checkout, or account form and no remote request.

claim: Finds readable article text on ordinary pages
where: How it works, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh DOM fixture with navigation, article, and sidebar text; assert the reader chooses only the article source without a request.

claim: Marks the source sentence while reading
where: Landing preview, how it works, README
sandbox: Fresh production MV3 build in Chromium; use three sentences in one wrapping paragraph, move forward and back by keyboard, and assert every visible overlay equals the browser range for the current sentence.

claim: Supports Alt + R, Alt + Left, and Alt + Right
sandbox: Fresh test environment; dispatch each documented key combination and assert replay, previous, and next commands in order.

claim: Does not read pages that explicitly prohibit copying or archiving
sandbox: Fresh noarchive DOM fixture; invoke replay and assert no reader action is performed.

claim: Keeps current sentence and speed in memory without creating a reading history
sandbox: Inspect the extension runtime state and assert position and speed are in-memory variables with no localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, or extension-storage call.

claim: Reads the active page only after the reader invokes the extension
sandbox: Fresh production extension build; assert no static content script or host permission exists, only activeTab plus scripting are requested, and the reader bundle is registered for explicit runtime injection.

claim: Downloads as a packaged browser extension
sandbox: Fresh production build; assert the landing link target exists, the ZIP is valid, and its manifest identifies the expected MV3 extension.

claim: Listen Back has no server, tracking, accounts, analytics, diagnosis, or generated voice
where: Landing limits, privacy page, README privacy section
sandbox: Inspect every shipped runtime entry point, dependency, and manifest permission; assert no network client, telemetry, identity, account, billing, or upload implementation. Browser speech is covered separately.

where: Landing preview, demo, extension popup, README
sandbox: Fresh production MV3 build in Chromium; start speech in an article, send Stop reading, and assert speech cancellation plus a non-speaking reader state.

claim: The extension download installs through desktop Chrome or Chromium after extraction
sandbox: Inspect the MV3 manifest and the public installation instructions for the extracted-folder Load unpacked path and the desktop-only notice.
Fresh browser context at /demo?demo=1 with a 390 by 844 viewport; assert the persistent demo banner and read control are visible inside the first viewport.
